name: genpark-personal-digital-hoarding-declutter-agent-skill
description: Personal digital asset decluttering agent classifying orphaned downloads, duplicate screenshots, and stale browser bookmarks.
author: AlphaPark

tools.name: analyze_file_batch
tools.description: Categorize files into archive, delete, or keep tiers based on age and access frequency.

tools.name: detect_duplicate_files
tools.description: Identify identical or near-duplicate files via content hash and name heuristics.

tools.name: calculate_revisit_probability
tools.description: Score mathematical probability that an orphaned file will ever be reopened.
